name: Lightpanda Browser
description: Headless browser built from scratch in Zig (16x less memory, 9x faster than Chromium). Fetches pages to markdown / semantic tree / HTML, drives interactive browsing through 40 MCP tools (click, fill, extract, screenshot, evaluate), and replays deterministic PandaScript. Uses a local binary only. Per-site cookie profiles (configure them on this settings page) let lightpanda_fetch reach login-gated pages, one session per site.
brief: You can browse the web with Lightpanda — a fast, low-memory headless browser. Load this skill with `use_skill('lightpanda')` to fetch pages as markdown, read the semantic tree, click/fill forms, extract structured data, take screenshots, or run PandaScript.
author: Evonic

variables.name: lightpanda_bin
variables.label: Binary path
variables.description: Explicit path to the lightpanda executable. Empty = auto-detect ($LIGHTPANDA_BIN, skills/lightpanda/bin/lightpanda, then PATH).

variables.name: lightpanda_host
variables.label: MCP host
variables.description: Interface the auto-started MCP (HTTP) server binds to.

variables.name: lightpanda_port
variables.label: MCP port
variables.description: TCP port of the auto-started MCP (HTTP) server.

variables.name: lightpanda_obey_robots
variables.label: Obey robots.txt
variables.description: Fetch and honor robots.txt for every request. Recommended for crawling, leave off for pages you are authorized to read.

variables.name: lightpanda_block_private_networks
variables.label: Block private networks
variables.description: Refuse requests to private/internal IPs after DNS resolution (SSRF guard). Disable only to reach a trusted intranet host.

variables.name: lightpanda_cookie_profiles
variables.label: Cookie profiles (per site)
variables.description: One entry per site: key = match pattern (host 'x.com' also matches www.x.com, wildcard '*.x.com', or a URL prefix 'https://x.com/i/lists/'), value = that site's cookies ('name=value; name2=value2', a Netscape cookies.txt, or a Puppeteer JSON array). The most specific pattern wins. Used by lightpanda_fetch only.

variables.name: lightpanda_cookie_file
variables.label: Legacy single cookie jar (optional)
variables.description: Advanced/legacy: path to ONE cookie jar used when no per-site profile matches (Netscape cookies.txt or Puppeteer JSON). Empty = <state dir>/cookies.json. Prefer the per-site profiles above.
